notes: New version of the Control Panel theme. It now sets every one of the 90 values the design system exposes, so the whole window follows it rather than just the colours.
The theme brings its own icons. All thirty are Phosphor Regular, supplied by the theme itself, which means a future theme can replace the entire icon set the same way it replaces colours.
List rows follow the theme now. They were held at a fixed height that no theme could change, which is why lists stayed loose while everything around them tightened.
